title: Trump visit stirs Zambales fishers' fears over US military presence

blocks.text: Fisherfolk in Zambales province have reiterated their opposition to the proposed construction of a United States (US) ammunition factory in Subic Bay, warning that the project could pave the way for the return of a US military presence in the area. Fisherfolk group Pamalakaya said in a statement on Friday that local fisherfolk associations joined in calling for US President Donald Trump to stay away during a consultation this week, ahead of his visit to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit that begins on Monday (November 16).
